name: OpenTubeX Sync Server
description: A self-hosted sync server for OpenTubeX subscriptions, playlists, history, and settings.
author: OpenTubeX

form_fields.label: Sync server secret
form_fields.hint: Keep this secret unchanged and back it up with the database; changing it locks out existing accounts.

form_fields.label: Allow registration
form_fields.hint: Disable after creating your accounts if no more registrations are needed.

form_fields.label: Database migration approval
form_fields.hint: Leave empty normally. After a verified backup, enter the exact pending versions from the server logs, comma-separated, then clear this field after migration.
